q: What were total obligations in FY2024?
sql: SELECT ROUND(SUM(obligation),2) FROM awards WHERE fiscal_year = 2024

q: Top 5 vendors by obligations in FY2023
sql: SELECT recipient_name, ROUND(SUM(obligation),2) t FROM awards WHERE fiscal_year = 2023 GROUP BY recipient_name ORDER BY t DESC LIMIT 5

q: How much did the Department of Defense spend on janitorial services?
sql: SELECT ROUND(SUM(obligation),2) FROM awards WHERE awarding_agency = 'Department of Defense' AND naics_code = '561720'

q: Show total spending by agency for fiscal year 2025
sql: SELECT awarding_agency, ROUND(SUM(obligation),2) t FROM awards WHERE fiscal_year = 2025 GROUP BY awarding_agency ORDER BY t DESC

q: What share of Department of Veterans Affairs obligations were sole source?
sql: SELECT ROUND(100.0*SUM(CASE WHEN extent_competed='NOT COMPETED' THEN obligation ELSE 0 END)/SUM(obligation),2) FROM awards WHERE awarding_agency = 'Department of Veterans Affairs'

q: How many contracts did GSA award in FY2022?
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM awards WHERE fiscal_year = 2022 AND awarding_agency = 'General Services Administration'

q: Spending trend by fiscal year for engineering services
sql: SELECT fiscal_year, ROUND(SUM(obligation),2) FROM awards WHERE naics_code = '541330' GROUP BY fiscal_year ORDER BY fiscal_year

q: Top 3 contractors for the Department of Energy
sql: SELECT recipient_name, ROUND(SUM(obligation),2) t FROM awards WHERE awarding_agency = 'Department of Energy' GROUP BY recipient_name ORDER BY t DESC LIMIT 3

q: Obligations by set aside type in FY2024
sql: SELECT set_aside_type, ROUND(SUM(obligation),2) t FROM awards WHERE fiscal_year = 2024 GROUP BY set_aside_type ORDER BY t DESC

q: What percent of spending was sole source in fiscal year 2021?
sql: SELECT ROUND(100.0*SUM(CASE WHEN extent_competed='NOT COMPETED' THEN obligation ELSE 0 END)/SUM(obligation),2) FROM awards WHERE fiscal_year = 2021

q: How much did NASA spend on research and development in the physical sciences?
sql: SELECT ROUND(SUM(obligation),2) FROM awards WHERE awarding_agency = 'National Aeronautics and Space Administration' AND naics_code = '541715'

q: Top 10 recipients of small business set-aside obligations
sql: SELECT recipient_name, ROUND(SUM(obligation),2) t FROM awards WHERE set_aside_type <> 'NONE' GROUP BY recipient_name ORDER BY t DESC LIMIT 10

q: Total spending by fiscal year for the Department of Homeland Security
sql: SELECT fiscal_year, ROUND(SUM(obligation),2) FROM awards WHERE awarding_agency = 'Department of Homeland Security' GROUP BY fiscal_year ORDER BY fiscal_year

q: How many awards were made for data processing and hosting services in FY2025?
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM awards WHERE fiscal_year = 2025 AND naics_code = '518210'

q: Which agency spent the most on computer systems design services?
sql: SELECT awarding_agency, ROUND(SUM(obligation),2) t FROM awards WHERE naics_code = '541512' GROUP BY awarding_agency ORDER BY t DESC

q: Total obligations for the Department of Transportation in fiscal year 2023
sql: SELECT ROUND(SUM(obligation),2) FROM awards WHERE fiscal_year = 2023 AND awarding_agency = 'Department of Transportation'
